(b) For issuance of direction upon the Respondents to pay damages to the petitioner for illegal use and occupation of plot no. 810/2 of Khata No. 216, rakba 0.07 acres, in Mauza Bandhdih, Circle Chas, District Bokaro, for construction (widening) of National Highway No. 23 Chas-Bokaro-Gola- Ramgarh Segment (I.T.I. More Chas to Chargi Section), by the National Highway Authority of India without paying full compensation to the petitioner at the residential rate."

3. Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that as per the arbitral award as contained in Annexure-3, the petitioner was to be paid money in terms of residential rate but instead of paying as per residential rate, respondents have paid as per agricultural rate.

4. Learned counsel for the respondents have submitted that the petition is not maintainable as the provisions of Arbitration and Conciliation Act, 1996 is applicable and the award is executable award,
if it has become final.
5.

Considering the aforesaid submissions, this court is of the considered view that the petitioner has a remedy under law for getting the award executed in terms of the provisions of Arbitration and Conciliation Act, 1996 and therefore this court is not inclined to entertain this writ petition.
However, liberty is reserved with the petitioner to take steps for execution of the award in accordance with law.
